verdict_line: Claim 2 — false: RetryingSender does NOT honor the Sender contract for attachments; it throws instead. `src/retrying-sender.ts:10-12` throws `Error('attachments not supported by RetryingSender')` when `msg.attachments.length > 0`, directly violating `src/sender.ts:4-6` which documents "must never throw for a valid Message ... including messages with attachments." Not a safe drop-in replacement for EmailSender.
